parsed.summary: The PR refactors AutocompleteJsonView to support extra fields in the autocomplete response, which is a useful enhancement. The changes are minimal and well-structured.

issues.description: The new files myapp/__init__.py and myapp/apps.py are not necessary for the functionality of the PR and should be removed.
The new test file test_autocomplete.py lacks proper documentation and comments, making it harder to understand the purpose and logic of the tests.
